scenarios.title: Balanced construction vs superstar stack
scenarios.instruction: Play this once, then read the box score. Whose offense looked organized, and who fought over the same shots?
scenarios.tradeoff: A balanced five gives up peak talent for fit; a stack gives up spacing, defense and ball-sharing for stars.

scenarios.title: Same rosters, contrasting coaches
scenarios.instruction: Identical teams. Watch pace, assisted play and where each side's shots came from.
scenarios.tradeoff: A grinding defensive coach trades possessions for control; a motion coach trades control for movement and threes.

scenarios.title: Same matchup, contrasting Era Style
scenarios.instruction: Play this in the 1960s era, then rematch the same matchup after switching the Era Style to 2010s. What changed?
scenarios.tradeoff: An old-era environment rewards interior size and pace; a modern one rewards spacing and shooting range.

scenarios.title: Movement offense
scenarios.instruction: Watch Gold's shot mix and assist count. Did off-ball movement and passing feel visible in the result?
scenarios.tradeoff: A movement offense earns quality looks without a dominant handler, but depends on screens and timing instead of isolation bailouts.

scenarios.title: Elite defensive construction
scenarios.instruction: Focus on Blue's shooting percentages, turnovers and free throws. Did the defense shape the game believably?
scenarios.tradeoff: An all-defense five concedes shot creation; a firepower five concedes stops. Something has to give.

scenarios.title: Size versus small ball
scenarios.instruction: Compare rebounds and points in the paint against threes and pace. Did each build get what it paid for?
scenarios.tradeoff: Size wins the glass and the paint; small ball wins tempo and the arc. Neither should get both.

scenarios.title: Spacing versus interior defense
scenarios.instruction: Blue's rim protectors want to live in the paint. Did Gold's shooting pull them out of it?
scenarios.tradeoff: Five-out spacing drags shot-blockers away from the rim, but bets the game on jump shooting against elite closeouts.

scenarios.title: Post mismatch and counter-adjustment
scenarios.instruction: Gold has a giant post advantage. Watch whether the offense finds it — and what the smaller defense gives up to slow it.
scenarios.tradeoff: Feeding a mismatch is efficient until the defense collapses on it; the counter is open shooters, not more post-ups.
